item.title: MANTRA OM Token Hits Record Low After Blockchain Exploit
item.summary: MANTRA’s OM token fell sharply to a record low after MANTRA Chain halted block production following a software exploit, adding fresh pressure to a project that has already faced significant challenges. The network suspended transactions and several related operations while developers investigated the incident and worked on a software fix.
